Many people experience increased hair fall during monsoon due to a combination of humidity, scalp issues, and environmental changes. At Kapil’s Salon, we help clients understand the root cause of seasonal hair fall and recommend solutions tailored to their hair and scalp needs.

One of the most common reasons for monsoon hair fall is excessive humidity. High moisture levels can make the scalp oily, attract dirt and pollutants, and create an environment where dandruff and scalp irritation thrive. Frequent exposure to rainwater, improper drying of hair, and changes in hair care routines can also contribute to weakened hair strands and increased shedding

The good news is that seasonal hair fall can often be managed with the right scalp care, nourishing treatments, and professional guidance. Our experts assess your scalp condition and recommend suitable hair spas, scalp treatments, and home-care routines to help maintain healthier-looking hair throughout the season.
